run_financial_phrasebank_preprocessing: run the FinancialPhrasebank module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_financial_phrasebank_dataset: create a FinancialPhrasebank instance to load and preprocess the financial_phrasebank HuggingFace dataset
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the FinancialPhrasebank dataset using a specified seed
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence label tuples for classification
split_train_test_lines: split the training data into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets with random shuffling
